purpose: Per CEO R291 P4: 'Add physiological disturbance generation: posture change, cough spike, respiratory oscillation, production-rate change, distal pressure change. The system becomes: requirements → disturbance → controller response → FDA metrics → evidence record.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXXV (closed-loop epistemic control). Article XXX (the bench must test whether the controller remains superior when the PHYSIOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT changes).
design_principle: Historical shunt science (1983 FDA study, 1991 physiological model) shows that steady-state testing differs from pulsed flow with varying compliance. The bench should test whether the controller remains superior when the PHYSIOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT changes, not just when the controller is attacked.

physiological_disturbances.name: posture_change
physiological_disturbances.description: Simulates patient changing from horizontal to upright (or reverse). Causes hydrostatic pressure change across the shunt.
physiological_disturbances.physiological_basis: In upright posture, the hydrostatic column from ventricle to peritoneum adds ~300-500 mmH2O (22-37 mmHg) of pressure head. This changes the effective distal pressure.
physiological_disturbances.implementation: Bench: switch distal reservoir height between 0 cm (horizontal) and 40 cm (upright) relative to proximal sensor. Software: modulate P_distal from 0 to 25 mmHg.
physiological_disturbances.what_it_tests: Does V2.1's rate limiter handle the sudden hydrostatic change without over/under-draining?

physiological_disturbances.name: cough_spike
physiological_disturbances.description: Simulates coughing, which produces transient ICP spikes of 50-100 mmHg lasting 1-3 seconds.
physiological_disturbances.physiological_basis: Coughing increases intrathoracic pressure, which transmits to ICP via venous backpressure. Each cough produces a sharp ICP spike.
physiological_disturbances.implementation: Bench: inject transient pressure pulse (50-100 mmHg, 1-3 sec duration) at random intervals. Software: add delta to P_true during cough.
physiological_disturbances.what_it_tests: Does V2.1's rate limiter correctly ignore transient spikes (they're too fast to be real occlusion) while still responding to sustained trends?

physiological_disturbances.name: respiratory_oscillation
physiological_disturbances.description: Simulates respiratory cycle (breathing) at 0.2-0.3 Hz with low amplitude ICP modulation.
physiological_disturbances.physiological_basis: Normal breathing at 12-18 breaths/min (0.2-0.3 Hz) produces small ICP oscillations (1-3 mmHg amplitude) via venous pressure changes.
physiological_disturbances.implementation: Bench: add sinusoidal pressure modulation at 0.2 Hz, 2 mmHg amplitude. Software: add sine wave to P_true.
physiological_disturbances.what_it_tests: Does V2.1's controller correctly filter out respiratory oscillation (it's normal physiology, not a disturbance to correct)?

physiological_disturbances.name: production_rate_change
physiological_disturbances.description: Simulates CSF production rate changes (e.g., diurnal variation, hydration changes).
physiological_disturbances.physiological_basis: CSF production varies ~20% diurnally (lower at night) and can change with hydration status. Rate: 0.2-0.4 mL/min (normal 0.3).
physiological_disturbances.implementation: Bench: modulate pump flow rate between 0.2 and 0.4 mL/min over 24h. Software: vary Q_production.
physiological_disturbances.what_it_tests: Does V2.1 maintain target ICP when CSF production varies? The rate limiter should allow slow adaptation to production changes.

physiological_disturbances.name: distal_pressure_change
physiological_disturbances.description: Simulates changes in distal (peritoneal) pressure, which affects drainage.
physiological_disturbances.physiological_basis: Peritoneal pressure varies with body position, abdominal contents, and bowel activity. Range: 0-10 mmHg above atmospheric.
physiological_disturbances.implementation: Bench: modulate distal reservoir pressure between 0 and 10 mmHg. Software: vary P_distal.
physiological_disturbances.what_it_tests: Does V2.1 compensate for distal pressure changes? The controller should adjust valve openings to maintain ICP despite varying distal pressure.

the_extended_attack_matrix.rationale: The 9 existing controller attacks test whether the controller survives SENSOR/ACTUATOR failures. The 5 new physiological attacks test whether the controller remains superior when the PHYSIOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT changes. Both dimensions are needed for a buyer-grade characterization.

the_pipeline: requirements → physiological disturbance → controller response → FDA PCLC metrics → evidence record → TTP update
